decision: Drop InstanceNorm from the discriminator and broadcast conditioning words into its first conv (early fusion); keep late concat.
evidence: probe_noise_vs_word_sensitivity: noise-only delta rose 0.0069->0.0268, word-only delta 0.0083->0.4209; InstanceNorm was erasing the brightness statistics D needs, leaving it at chance.
alternatives: more training, extra loss terms, bigger G
status: superseded by the research/measure path; GAN frozen

decision: Produce images by measuring researched photographs into committed VisualFacts and rendering them deterministically; no diffusion, no montage, no per-subject code.
evidence: ../grounded is the theory (does not work); measure.rs + scene.rs render plate-0000 within its measured bbox [64,18,133,224].
alternatives: keep training the GAN; hosted diffusion backend

decision: Split the mask into connected components and cluster pieces that share columns (overlap in x) as one subject; record every other region beside the figure without claiming it.
evidence: Hals plate: Commons documents a coat-of-arms to the left; components are torso [64,18,133,99], skirt [64,187,97,224], coat-of-arms [35,167,51,200] recorded-beside and excluded.
alternatives: largest single blob (measured only the head)

decision: Measure silhouette width as horizontal extent; for a bucket the plate showed nothing in (black silk dress on dark ground), carry width between measured neighbours and paint the plate's own color there, flagging it in profile_covered.
evidence: plate-0000 dress band y102-166 is indistinguishable from surround (color distance RMS ~6, Otsu-pass 3.6%); profile_covered marks 9 carried buckets.
alternatives: density profile (collapsed the middle); interpolate an invented width/colour

decision: Refuse a cluster that runs off the frame as a scene, not a bounded subject.
evidence: 35-plate bank: 6 bounded subjects (0,2,6,16,24,25), 28 refused as scenes, 1 no separable subject; isolatable figures and the Barye sculpture pass, subjects inside scenes do not.
alternatives: accept whole-frame region as subject (rendered a meaningless slab); accept-but-flag

decision: A refusal is never terminal: it states what to clarify and invites another run rather than stopping.
evidence: the image and coding loops share one rule — no dead ends, clarify with the user then repeat with the clarification.
